body: filemark file.id schemes: FSA folder file = <folderId>:<relativePath>; drop-dir file = drop-dir:<folderId>:<relPath>; loose intercept = intercept:<fileUrl>; loose drop = drop:<uuid>. folder.label is a user override to disambiguate same-named folders (falls back to name); folder.rootPath is the manually-pasted absolute path enabling Open-in-editor/Reveal-in-Finder (FSA hides real paths).
